trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Saul: One Pokémon. That's all I carry up this road, and all I've ever needed!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Saul: ...Perhaps I'll think about a second.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Pokémon Ranger Felicia: Ash falls on everything up here, and still the grass comes through it. So do the Pokémon. So do I!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Pokémon Ranger Felicia: You came through it best of all.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Black Belt Griffin: I train at the mouth of a volcano! Hot rock under my feet, ash in my eyes! Nothing can shake me!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Black Belt Griffin: Shaken! By a traveller! Back to the hot rocks!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Mikayla: Tooth, claw and horn. My three have a sharp answer for everything. What's your question?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Mikayla: That was a question I hadn't an answer to.
